photoHook: Attach later JPEGs on the listing photos (and images) arrays as https:// URLs or /uploads/ paths. The shopper map already renders those fields. Typical vendor-portal files land at https://vfm.buzzonmarketing.com/vendor-photos/<vendor-id>/<timestamp>.jpg. After editing this file run `node scripts/apply-published-listings.js` and deploy thefairmap on Vercel.
